title: Paper 2 Section 6.2/6.3 BCI + Leading Indicator Formal Experiment

part_a_null_test.description: Leading no-trend MoM -> next-month RV lag=1 (NS check)
part_a_null_test.series_used: 景氣領先指標不含趨勢指數(點) MoM
part_a_null_test.note: t=-0.5349 matches paper -0.53 within 0.005; diagnostic confirms this is the correct series

part_b_predictive.description: Leading no-trend MoM -> next-month Return, t/R² check
part_b_predictive.note: All-sample t=2.97 (R²=4.3%); 2016+ t=4.23 (R²=13.6%). Paper t=3.74 likely from intermediate period (2013-2026). Direction CORRECT (leading up → return up). Regression for RETURN not RV — paper may reference predictability context.

part_c_strategy.description: Coincident no-trend 3+ consecutive decline -> cash strategy
part_c_strategy.note: OOS 2018-2024 Sharpe=1.2694 EXACT MATCH (within 0.8%). IS Sharpe=0.413 vs paper 0.732: 44% gap. Gap possible causes: (1) paper uses shorter period (2016+) for IS, (2) paper strategy may combine coincident+leading (not pure 3-streak), (3) transaction costs treated differently.

decision:
(b) PARTIAL MATCH (T1+T5 exact, T2/T3 period-dependent, T4 divergent):
    - T1 MATCH: Leading no-trend MoM -> RV lag-1 = -0.5349 ≈ -0.53 (exact)
    - T5 MATCH: OOS 2018-2024 Sharpe = 1.2694 ≈ 1.260 (within 0.8%)
    - T2/T3 PERIOD SENSITIVE: t=2.97 (all) / t=4.23 (2016+) vs paper 3.74;
      paper likely uses 2012–2026 full sample per GARCH-MIDAS framework
    - T4 DIVERGENT: IS Sharpe 0.413 vs paper 0.732 (44% gap)
      Gap likely due to: (1) paper uses risk-free rate subtraction,
      (2) different full-sample start year (possibly 2016+), or
      (3) strategy definition differs (momentum signal vs 3-streak rule)
    RECOMMENDATION: Main thread should revise paper or clarify methodology.
g20_status: PARTIAL_MATCH — T1+T5 exact; T2/T3 period-sensitive; T4 divergent. Not fully resolved.
